objectives:
This course introduces to the students the theoretical concepts and practical techniques of financial statement analysis. After taking this course, students should be able to:
(1)	Evaluate a company's financial well-being, current performance, and outlook by using financial statements and ratio analysis.
(2)	Be familiar with forecasting and planning techniques.
(3)	Prepare pro forma financial statements and assess the firm's valuation.
